chunks: The narration of Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, through his chain, from Yūnus, from Ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Concerning one who comes to a beast and penetrates, he said: “Upon him is the hadd of the fornicator.”

key_terms.ٱلْبَهِيمَةَ: the animal or beast involved in the act

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling in Shia hadith for one who has intercourse with an animal?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who has intercourse with an animal. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that such a person is subject to the hadd punishment of the fornicator.
